title: Cassine Dream | KEY.co
description_expanded: Culinary enthusiasts will find themselves at home in the well-appointed kitchen, where stainless steel appliances glint beside sleek quartz countertops. White cabinetry and a commodious pantry stand ready to store all manner of treats and ingredients, while the expansive breakfast bar expands seating options, complementing a dining room table that welcomes a dozen diners with ease. Details such as utensils, cooking supplies, a convenient phone charging port, and a Bluetooth Sony speaker for setting the ambiance are all at guests’ fingertips. Adjacent to this space, the inviting living area beckons with comfortable seating and a flat-screen TV, while those mixing leisure with business will appreciate the high-speed internet, ensuring productivity is as breezy as the Gulf Coast air. The practical addition of a laundry room underscores the home's commitment to providing a seamless and carefree experience.
